title: Key role of short-lived halogens on global atmospheric oxidation during historical periods
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, 5,547-562
DOI: 10.1039/D4EA00141A, Paper

Adriana Bossolasco, Rafael P. Fernandez, Qinyi Li, Anoop S. Mahajan, Julián Villamayor, Javier A. Barrera, Dwayne E. Heard, Carlos A. Cuevas, Cyril Caram, Sophie Szopa, Alfonso Saiz-Lopez
Short-lived halogens (SLH) play a crucial role in reducing atmospheric oxidation over time, this effect is more pronounced in the pre-industrial period, primarily due to enhanced halogen reactivity under low-NOx conditions.
